Hi! I was wondering if anyone could help me figure if I'm doing something wrong or if I just need to wait and gain a few levels. I'm trying to clear the last chapter of the last section of Arc 1 on hard mode, and I can't kill the boss... I can get to the part where it splits and then comes back whole, but at that point it's so tanky and deals so much damage I can't beat it even if I try to save the special cards I get during the fight. One emergency gnosis is not enough for me so I'm wondering how people clear this without using any 😭

My limited characters are: OE Pollux, E3 Horla / Saya / GLotan, E2 Tulu / Miryam, E1 Sorel / Salvador / Murphy / Wanda, E0 Tawil / Hameln / Thais / Lily / Daffodil / Doresain. (Not currently planning to get any new ones in this patch.) I also have a few limited wheels including Saya's. If I remember correctly I also took Aegis to E3 while Erica and Aurita are still E0.

All the characters I've used to try and clear this level are lvl 60 or above with lvl 3 skills for supports and lvl 5-6 for Pollux/GLotan/Saya. My current level is 60.

I've mainly been trying to clear using GLotan (with monochaos, Saya, Miryam) and Pollux (with Saya and various other combos of ultra/caro supports). The issue is that GLotan can oneshot its first 3-4 phases, but when command cards start to disappear it's hard to get her ult up and she doesn't deal enough damage anyway. The issue with Pollux comes when the boss starts clearing debuffs from itself.

Edit: Ended up beating it with 2 Emergency Gnosis (the second one would have been unnecessary if I'd played the previous turns more carefully) so if anyone has the time to check the replay and give me some feedback I'd be super grateful! I can already see a lot of misplays/misplanning on my own but maybe there's something more precise I haven't considered

content:
You should absolutely try to clear at least a1 on all waves.
But I suggest you start at a2 : doesn't cost anything and might yield results.

As for the whale borrow : a properly fed Mouchette ( or another potent dps ) should see you through alert 5 on the wave you have most troubles with.

-> First try a2 on all waves
-> Change your linups to accomodate each wave's specific challenge -> borrow a whale for your least favorite wave
